methodology: A/B test of every non-redirect skill native to mikkonumminen.dev. Arm A: Sonnet sub-agent solves the task cold, no SKILL.md access, explicit instruction not to read .claude/skills/ or CLAUDE.md. Arm B: Sonnet sub-agent reads d:/koodaamista/mikkonumminen.dev/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and follows it. Both arms produced a planning artifact (skills here are meta — execute would have side effects on registry/PDF/READMEs). Token usage from harness's per-sub-agent usage.total_tokens — input + output + cache_creation; cache_read excluded. N=1 per skill.

cross_portfolio_observation: Aggregate +21% saved lands between AudiobookMaker (+23%) and Spacepotatis (+22%), and well above claude-skills (-10%). The mixed shape (2 save big, 2 cost slightly more) reflects that mikkonumminen.dev's 4 skills span both pattern families: skill-localUpdate and md-to-pdf are pipeline-orchestration skills (recipe collapses tool-selection), skill-registry and sync-readmes are meta skills (recipe encodes thoroughness). Same skill-shape rule observed across all four portfolios: scaffolding / tool-selection saves big, meta / library / procedure-rigor skills break even or cost more.
